offers.sn: YOUR RESPONSABILITIES Fulfillment and respect of the HSE requirement at site and to intervene should the requirements not be respected nor fulfilled. Quantity and quality of the mechanical work in accordance with the related instructions.
offers.rq: YOUR PROFILE Completed vocational training or university degree in Electronics /Mechatronics or similar field. Several years of vocational experience as Electrician on wind farms and a depth technical knowledge of wind turbines. Good English language skills (read, write and speak fluently).
